# onpager_voice_provider (Resource)

Manage one tenant voice-provider connection and its owned delivery channel. Configuration validation performs no provider requests or calls.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "zvonok_public_key" {
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  description = "Zvonok API v1 public key. It persists in Terraform state and saved plans."
}

resource "onpager_voice_provider" "example" {
  kind         = "zvonok"
  display_name = "Primary voice"
  enabled      = false

  configuration = {
    call_campaign_id         = "100001"
    verification_campaign_id = "100002"
    max_text_runes           = 500
  }

  secrets = {
    public_key = {
      action = "replace"
      value  = var.zvonok_public_key
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Attributes) Typed Zvonok configuration. Both campaigns must already exist; Terraform performs no campaign or account probe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration))
- `display_name` (String) Nonblank UTF-8 display name, at most 200 bytes, without control characters or surrounding whitespace. Names need not be unique. Updated in place; no default.
- `kind` (String) Immutable voice-provider kind, currently `zvonok` only. Changing kind replaces the resource. The resource UUID is also its managed delivery-channel UUID.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connection is enabled. Defaults to `true`. Explicit false creates it disabled atomically; disabled resources still require complete valid configuration and public_key. Saving or refreshing performs no external validation or call.
- `secrets` (Attributes Map) Explicit named credential changes; only `public_key` is supported. Create requires replace with a nonempty value. Updates preserve stored credentials when the map/key is omitted, null or empty; keep also preserves them. Unchanged configured replacements are not replayed during unrelated updates. Known values survive refresh while the key is present. Import cannot recover values; external replacement is undetectable. Configured values persist in Terraform state and saved plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secrets))
- `team_ids` (Set of String) Whole explicit channel grant set of at most 1000 nonzero canonical lowercase team UUIDs. Omitted/null and empty both clear all grants. Must be empty for global visibility; team visibility permits an empty set. No team is discovered or created.
- `visibility` (String) Channel visibility: `global` (default) or `team`. Global visibility requires an empty team_ids set.

### Read-Only

- `callback_url` (String, Sensitive) Optional secret-bearing inbound callback URL. Null when the server omits it because ingress URL or decryption is unavailable. API-key rotation preserves its identity. It persists in Terraform state; Terraform never calls or configures it remotely.
- `id` (String) Stable nonzero canonical lowercase OnPager UUID.
- `runtime_error_code` (String) Optional safe local runtime error code; null when omitted. No credential or provider response is exposed.
- `runtime_observed_at` (String) Optional authoritative runtime observation timestamp with its returned offset and precision; null when omitted. No timestamp is synthesized.
- `runtime_status` (String) Observed local runtime state: disabled, starting, reconfiguring, running or error. Running proves local owner/configuration readiness, not external account, balance or campaign validity.
- `secret_keys` (Set of String) Credential names confirmed present by the API. Values are never returned; import recovers names only.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Required:

- `call_campaign_id` (String) Existing advanced free-text campaign identifier, 1–128 UTF-8 bytes without control characters or surrounding whitespace. No default.
- `verification_campaign_id` (String) Existing separate tellcode phone-verification campaign identifier, 1–128 UTF-8 bytes without control characters or surrounding whitespace. No default. Terraform never enrolls or verifies phones.

Optional:

- `max_text_runes` (Number) Maximum rendered Unicode rune count, from 1 through 500 inclusive. Defaults to `500`; explicit zero is invalid.


<a id="nestedatt--secrets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secrets`

Required:

- `action` (String) `replace` writes a nonempty public_key; `keep` retains the required stored key. Required public_key cannot be deleted. Omission never implies deletion.

Optional:

- `value` (String, Sensitive) Write-only public API key, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes without control characters. Required, non-null and nonblank for replace; empty replacement is invalid. Omit/null/empty for keep. Known configured values remain in Terraform state while the key is present.

## Import

Import using the voice-provider UUID. It is also the owned delivery-channel UUID.
Display names are not identities and need not be unique. Import reads the exact
resource without changing enabled state, grants or credentials.

Use an `import` block:

```terraform
import {
  to = onpager_voice_provider.example
  id = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
}
```

Or use the CLI:

```shell
terraform import onpager_voice_provider.example 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222
```

## Configuration and lifecycle

This resource owns one tenant voice connection and the settings of its managed
delivery channel. Current `kind = "zvonok"` is immutable. Do not manage the same
channel through another writer. Visibility and the complete team grant set are
configured explicitly; omitted/null or empty team_ids clears the grants.

Both campaigns must already exist: use an advanced free-text campaign for calls
and a separate tellcode campaign for phone verification. Campaign identifiers
are 1–128 UTF-8 bytes. The display name is limited to 200 UTF-8 bytes. None may
contain control characters or surrounding whitespace. The rendered text limit
defaults to 500 Unicode runes and must be from 1 through 500; zero is invalid.

Enabled defaults to true. Explicit false creates the complete resource disabled
atomically. Saving and reading configuration performs no Zvonok request, account
or campaign probe, paid call, phone enrollment or verification. The provider does
not preview templates, send notifications, register callbacks remotely or discover
targets. Running runtime status means local configuration and ownership readiness;
it does not prove account, balance or campaign validity.

Updates replace complete public settings using unversioned PUT, then read the
exact UUID. No resource revision, ETag, If-Match or idempotency key is used.
Committed updates remain in state if the follow-up read fails. Mutations are not
retried automatically. If a create response is lost or lacks a usable UUID,
investigate whether it committed before applying again; do not identify it by
display name. A usable UUID from an incomplete success receipt is retained for
recovery, with a diagnostic.

Destroy sends DELETE and retires the connection when it has no retained
dependencies. Retirement disables the channel, erases credentials and preserves
immutable identity and delivery history; the management detail then returns404.
Retained targets, personal methods and configured channel bindings, including
disabled references, cause409 voice_provider_in_use. Resolve dependencies
explicitly. The provider never unlinks them or disables and forgets an object
after rejected retirement. Confirmed absence removes state; authorization,
transport and dependency errors retain it.

## Credentials and state

Only the required public_key credential is supported. Create requires
`secrets.public_key` with action replace and a nonempty value, including disabled
creation. Values must be nonblank UTF-8 without control characters, at most 4096
bytes. Empty or null replacement is invalid. The required key cannot be deleted.

During updates, omitted/null/empty secrets or an omitted individual key preserves
stored credentials. Explicit keep also preserves the key and sends no value;
omit value or use null/empty. Removing a map entry never deletes the server key.
The API never returns key values. Refresh retains known configured values while
key presence is confirmed; import recovers secret_keys only. After import, omit
secrets to preserve the stored key, or configure an explicit replacement.

Unchanged replace declarations are not replayed during unrelated updates. A
changed configured action/value, a newly configured replacement after import,
or a confirmed missing key causes the requested replacement. External replacement
of a present write-only key cannot be detected or reconciled from GET.

Configured sensitive values still persist in Terraform state and saved plans.
The optional computed callback_url contains a server-generated secret and is
also sensitive and persisted. It is null when the backend omits it; API-key
rotation preserves its stable identity. Terraform does not contact that URL.

## Permissions

Requires tenant-level `voice_providers.read`, `voice_providers.create`,
`voice_providers.update` and `voice_providers.delete`, including for explicitly
granted native service accounts. Creation and requested credential replacements
additionally require `voice_provider_credentials.replace`. Metadata and public
configuration updates preserve a saved key without that separate credential
grant. Account ownership and token issuance do not grant business access.

The server needs its voice credential keyring to create or replace credentials.
Deployment configuration errors such as503
voice_provider_credentials_unavailable retain state. Human phone methods and
their verification remain separate personal operations.
